rationale: DOS 2025-01-30, payer is commercial (CI). 835 denies both lines CO-29 (timely filing expired) with N211. But the 277CA shows the claim was accepted (STC A2:20) on 2025-02-16 — only 17 days after DOS, well within any commercial filing limit. The denial is erroneous; the provider has proof of timely submission. Appeal disputing the receipt date with the 277CA acceptance report.

root_cause.explanation: CO-29 applied to both lines but 277CA proves claim accepted 2025-02-16, 17 days post-DOS. Payer's receipt-date determination is wrong.

next_action.detail: Appeal with 277CA acceptance report (STC A2:20, date 2025-02-16) proving timely submission. Dispute payer's receipt date — do not resubmit.
